description: Implementation of the CordRepRing class managing a ring buffer for string representations in the Abseil library, including methods for appending, prepending, slicing, and validation of ring buffer segments.

classes.name: CordRepRing
classes.description: A class implementing a ring buffer for string segments, supporting appending, prepending, slicing, and validation operations.

classes.name: CordRepRing::Filler
classes.description: Helper class for filling entries in the ring buffer during append or prepend operations.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs the state of a CordRepRing to an ostream for debugging.

methods.name: AddDataOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the data offset of a specific entry in the ring.

methods.name: SubLength
methods.description: Adjusts the end position of a specific entry in the ring.

methods.name: CreateFromLeaf
methods.description: Creates a ring buffer from a leaf node (flat or external) with specified offset and length.

methods.name: CreateSlow
methods.description: Creates a ring buffer from a complex CordRep, possibly involving copying or creating subrings.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a ring buffer from a CordRep, dispatching based on type.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data or a CordRep to the ring buffer.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends data or a CordRep to the ring buffer.

methods.name: SubRing
methods.description: Creates a subring representing a slice of the current ring.

methods.name: RemovePrefix
methods.description: Removes a prefix of specified length from the ring buffer.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix of specified length from the ring buffer.

methods.name: GetCharacter
methods.description: Retrieves a character at a specific offset within the ring buffer.
